column1: # Mutation-testing scope (TST-002, issue #17): the domain, access and
# admission code. One line per scope root, tab-separated: the root (a
# module-relative directory, mutated with every package under it), the files
# under it that are in scope (* for all, or a comma-separated list), and the
# reason. Tests are never in scope. Admission (#8) adds its package here.
# internal/testkit/mutgate reads this file; scripts/mutation.sh runs Gremlins
# on the roots a change touches (pr) or on every root (full).
